name: Snail
description:
The Snails are a common infestation in these lands. They came here on vacation, and they move so slowly that they have not made it home in centuries.

They are still easy to salt. They are still slow, and the locals charge them double experience to learn anything. The one thing the shell got right is that it is armor, poison slides off the mucus, and a fall turns into a pour.

Everyone still says Snails have no redeeming qualities. "Snail" remains a common all-purpose slur.
